item.title: Pretty interior! Circa 1927 in Virginia. $334,950
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! Nice yard also. The house was built in 1927. It is located on .33 acre in Hopewell, Virginia. item.title: Double porch love! Almost six acres in Maryland! Fenced pasture. $515,000
item.description: Double porch love! That springhouse is pretty cool looking! Love that this property has outbuildings and a fenced pasture. The house was built in the mid 1800’s. It is located on 5.93 acres in Westminster, Maryland. The house features double front porches, exposed log walls, some original wood floors, baseboards, bay windows and a spacious kitchen. item.title: Pretty interior! A lot of natural light! One acre in Massachusetts. $238,000
item.description: This house has a lot of natural light! The kitchen is nice! The house was built in 1941. It is located on one acre in Hardwick, Massachusetts. The house features wood floors, vaulted ceiling, updated bathroom, exposed beams and a loft area. There is a firepit and raised garden beds on the property. One bedroom, one bathroom and 742 square feet. $238,000 Contact Lauren Mace with William Neylon Real Estate: 508-688-1125 From the Zillow listing: Discover the charm of this cozy 1-bed, 1-bath ranch n

item.title: This has character! Circa 1871 in Michigan. $299,900
item.description: This house has character! Loving the exterior details! The house was built in 1871. It is located on .35 acre in Romeo, Michigan. The house features a wrap around front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, arched entryway, exposed brick in the kitchen, vaulted ceiling, claw foot tub and built-in. The backyard is fenced with a large patio and a detached two car garage. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,902 square feet. $299,900 Contact Michael Mason with The Agency Hall and Hunter: 248-762-5

item.title: Pretty woodwork and pocket doors! C. 1898 in Minnesota. $285,000
item.description: This house has some pretty woodwork and pocket doors! Nice staircase! The house was built in 1898. It is located in St. Peter, Minnesota. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, nice staircase, pocket doors, stained glass windows, built-in seating, bay windows and baseboards. There is a detached garage behind the house. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,830 square feet. $285,000 Contact Shari Brostrom with Pell Real Estate From the Zillow listing: Welcome to 310 N Minnes

item.title: Look inside! That closet is amazing! Two acres in Mississippi. $325,000
item.description: This house has a lot of amazing details! I want that closet! The pool is nice too. This seems like a lot of house for the money! The house was built in 1933. It is located on two acres in Ruleville, Mississippi. The house features a porte cochere, beautiful crystal chandelier, wood floors, built-ins, original windows, knotty pine, french doors, arched entryways, breakfast room, game room, amazing master bathroom and a huge master closet. Outside there is a large pool and poolhouse. Four bedrooms

item.title: Long driveway! Spacious kitchen! Almost two acres in North Carolina. $295,000
item.description: Love the long driveway with this property! The kitchen looks spacious. The house was built in 1912. It is located on 1.75 acres in Troy, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, some wood flooring, spacious kitchen, coffered ceiling, baseboards and updated bathrooms. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,373 square feet. $295,000 Contact Jay Ross with Keller Williams Select: jayross@kw.com From the Zillow listing: This two story

item.title: Love the outbuildings! Over four acres in Virginia. $279,900
item.description: Nice outbuildings! Pretty setting! The house was built in 1870. It is located on 4.21 acres in Willis, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, baseboards, crown moulding, updated kitchen and an updated bathroom. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Wish they showed inside them. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,334 square feet. $279,900 Contact Darin Greear with Long and Foster – New River Valley: 540-320-5859 From the Zillow listing: Enjoy coun

item.title: Spanish Eclectic house in Missouri. C. 1927. $95,000
item.description: A Spanish Eclectic style home. Interesting how there are quite a few on this street in Missouri. The house was built in 1927. It is located in Joplin, Missouri. The Spanish Eclectic-Revival home features a stucco exterior, softly rounded parapets, arched entryways, wood floors, clay accent and a brick fireplace. There is a large unfinished basement, fenced in backyard and a detached storage shed. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 842 square feet. $95,000 Contact Ryan Flanagan with Indi Real Estate:

item.title: Nice wine cellar! Circa 1926 in Nebraska. $220,000
item.description: This house has a nice wine cellar! The house was built in 1926. It is located on .33 acre in Beatrice, Nebraska. The house features a small covered porch, sturdy looking staircase, original wood floors, baseboards, built-ins, original wood doors and a built-in china cabinet. There is a large basement with a wine cellar. There is a detached garage and a large fenced in backyard. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,738 square feet. $220,000 Contact Tessa Mangnall with Woods Bros Realty: 402-429-503
